p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust
steps: Ichigo Technique → Mayuri Ultimate → Technique → Battlefield → Nel Technique
Ichigo Basic Attack (3x) → Technique → Basic Attack → Technique → Ultimate → Nel Manual Counter → Special Attack → Nel Ultimate
Nel Special Attack → Manual Counter → Nel Technique (2x) → Mayuri Technique → Special Attack → Nel Ultimate
Ichigo Counter → Technique → Basic Attack (2x) → Technique → Basic Attack → Technique → Ultimate → Nel Ultimate → Ichigo Dodge (Transcendent State) → Basic Attack Spam
p2w-rotations.notes: This is a training rotation. The rotation used in Coop will be different.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Ranuganga
steps: Nelliel: BFS → Technique → swap to Ichigo
p2w-rotations.notes: Opener only: Ichigo should not need a rebuild at this tier. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Yammy Llargo
steps: Nelliel: BFS → Technique → swap to Ichigo
Ichigo: Basic Attack 3x → Technique 2 → Basic Attack → Technique 4 → Ultimate → swap to Nelliel
p2w-rotations.notes: Two cycles — the filler between them exists to get Ichigo back to a second Ultimate rather than to add damage. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Sajin Komamura
steps: Nelliel: Counter → BFS → Technique → swap to Ichigo
Ichigo: Counter → Technique 2 → Basic Attack → Technique 4 → Ultimate → swap to Nelliel
p2w-rotations.notes: Counter windows over greed. Slower than the General route, but it survives the phase transitions instead of trading Ichigo for them. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Ashisougi Jizo
steps: Nelliel: BFS → Technique → swap to Ichigo
Ichigo: Basic Attack 3x → Technique 2 → Basic Attack → Technique 4 → Ultimate → swap to Nelliel
p2w-rotations.notes: The longest of the set — assumes the fight outlives two full Ultimate cycles and that Ichigo needs every buff window twice. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Events
steps: Ichigo: Technique → Basic Attack 2x → Technique 2 → Basic Attack → Technique 4 → swap to Nelliel
p2w-rotations.notes: A closed loop with no opener and no Ultimate dump, so it holds up after the burst routes run dry. Bank Ichigo's Ultimate for whatever window the stage gives you. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.

p2w-rotations.name: True Shikai Mono Thrust — Frenzy Feast
steps: Nelliel: BFS → Technique → swap to Ichigo
p2w-rotations.notes: Front-loads every buff so Ichigo swings inside the full window — no second cycle, which is the trade a timed score push wants. Generated for the P2W route from this comp's own rotation — not play-tested yet.
